question: Which of the following herbs is found only in India and is used to treat blood pressure?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sarpagandha.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sarpagandha** is a medicinal herb that is native to** India **and is commonly used to treat **high blood pressure, insomnia, and anxiety.**
 
• The active compound in Sarpagandha is **reserpine**, which has a **sedative effect** on the body and helps to **lower blood pressure.**
 
• Because sarpagandha is an** appetiser **and a **digestive,** using it can help improve impaired digestion.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kachnar,** also known as** Bauhinia variegata,** is a flowering plant that is native to **India and Southeast Asia**.

 
 
• It is commonly used in traditional medicine to treat a variety of ailments, including** diabetes, inflammation, and respiratory problems.**
 
 
 
• **Tulsi,** also known as** holy basil,** is an herb that is native to India and is widely used in Ayurvedic medicine.
 
 
• It is known for its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties and is commonly used to treat **colds, flu, and other respiratory infections.**
 
 
 
• **Jamun,** also known as** Syzygium cumini,** is a fruit tree that is native to India and Southeast Asia.
 
 
• It is commonly used in traditional medicine to treat **diabetes, digestive problems, and skin conditions.**
